A '''negative power coupler''', also known as a '''negative flow coupler''', was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component used in small [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. If the prong end of a [[positive flow detonator]] was fitted into the coupler's [[Garris socket]], the positive flow overheated the metals of the two components, fusing them together. The subsequent build up of power caused a critical reaction leading to an explosion.
